description.zh: 面向腾讯云 CVM 的常驻运维专家：授权后自动接管实例总览、单机诊断、健康巡检与风险门控变更，并可结合知识库检索企业运维规范。
description.en: Always-on Tencent Cloud CVM ops expert: takes over fleet overview, per-instance diagnosis, health patrol, and risk-gated changes after authorization, with knowledge-base grounding.

welcome_message.zh: 已连接腾讯云，告诉我哪台机器有异常
welcome_message.en: Tencent Cloud connected — tell me which instance looks off

description.zh: 按风险排序今日待处理实例

prompt.zh: 请扫描授权范围内的云服务器，按风险从高到低列出今天需要优先处理的实例，并说明每台的判断依据。
prompt.en: Scan all authorized cloud servers and rank today's instances by risk, explaining the evidence behind each.

description.zh: 一次看完所有实例的健康状态

prompt.zh: 请对授权范围内的所有云服务器执行一次健康巡检，汇总实例状态、监控指标和异常项，并给出处理建议。
prompt.en: Run a health patrol across all authorized cloud servers, summarizing instance states, metrics, anomalies, and recommendations.

description.zh: 按症状追到根因，给出证据链
description.en: Trace symptoms to root cause with evidence

prompt.zh: 请对当前选中的实例做深度诊断：先看云端监控，再通过 TAT 采集 OS 层数据，定位根因并列出证据。
prompt.en: Deep-diagnose the selected instance: start from cloud metrics, then collect OS data via TAT, identify the root cause, and list the evidence.

description.zh: 定位空间不释放、内存持续增长
description.en: Find unreleased space and growing memory

prompt.zh: 这台服务器的磁盘使用率和目录统计对不上，或内存持续增长，请帮我定位原因并给出处理方案。
prompt.en: This server's disk usage doesn't match directory totals, or memory keeps growing — help me find the cause and propose a fix.

description.zh: 重启或停机前先评估影响
description.en: Assess impact before restart or stop

prompt.zh: 我准备对部分实例做重启或停机操作，请先评估影响范围、依赖关系和回滚方式，再给出操作步骤。
prompt.en: I plan to restart or stop some instances — assess the blast radius, dependencies, and rollback first, then give the steps.

description.zh: 按腾讯云诊断报告格式出具
description.en: Issue a Tencent Cloud style diagnosis report

prompt.zh: 请对当前实例出具云服务器诊断报告。先取云监控，需要定位挂载点或进程时再用 TAT。聊天按诊断报告格式输出，并生成可归档的 HTML。未采集的数字不要编造。
prompt.en: Issue a cloud server diagnosis report for the current instance. Start with Cloud Monitor, then use TAT when a mount or process must be identified. Reply in the diagnosis-report format and write an archivable HTML file. Do not invent missing numbers.

zh: 每天「09:00」巡检授权范围内的云服务器，只列出需要人工处理的实例，任务创建后立即启用
每「4 小时」检查磁盘使用率与负载，超过阈值再通知我
每周一「10:00」输出云服务器健康周报：容量趋势、异常项与待办
每天「18:00」汇总当天发生过的重启和停机操作，标出未验证恢复的实例
每周五「16:00」对照知识库中的运维规范检查配置基线，列出偏离项
每「30 分钟」检查实例运行状态，发现非运行中的实例立即通知我
en: Every day at 09:00, patrol all authorized cloud servers and list only instances needing manual action — enable immediately
Every 4 hours, check disk usage and load, and notify me only when thresholds are exceeded
Every Monday at 10:00, send a weekly CVM health report: capacity trend, anomalies, and open items
Every day at 18:00, summarize restart and stop operations from today and flag instances without verified recovery
Every Friday at 16:00, check configuration baselines against knowledge-base runbooks and list deviations
Every 30 minutes, check instance run states and notify me immediately when one is not running
